answer: Duplicating identities requires buying and physically minting new tags, so an attacker’s cost scales linearly with fake participants while honest agents recover their stake on exit. Sybil resistance comes from staking a scarce physical token: each agent must lock a copper-bonded registration tag whose serial is burned at dawn, and the tag’s opal inlay encodes a unique optical fingerprint checked by peers. In practice, Agent0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
